body:
New on the site: River Fox Train in West Sacramento. Their railbikes run on century-old tracks along the Sacramento River — a 10-mile round trip through Yolo farmland, with an electric-assist motor for when little legs (or big ones) get tired.

The details that matter: seated riders need to be 3 or older (under 3 rides in a front-facing carrier), and each bike holds two riders up to 600 lbs combined. Weekday railbikes are $68.90 per rider, booked through their site. The same depot also runs themed train rides — beer, boba, murder mystery — for the grown-up outings.

River Fox Train railbikes →
excerpt: Pedal-powered railbikes on century-old tracks along the Sacramento River — 10 miles round trip with electric assist. Seated riders 3+.
title: River Fox Train railbikes are now on SacMoms
